messages:
Alex K: Quick follow-up from the postmortem  we need concrete owners & dates for rollout guardrail work: auto-rollback, flag scoping, recurrence detection.
Maria P: I can own auto-rollback. Will share multi-signal thresholds + short canary plan by Thu EOD.
Jon S: I'll own blast-radius controls (flag scoping + saturation caps). Plan ready by next Tue.
Irene C: I'll prototype recurrence-detection rules (flag+model grouping) and wire alerts; target: end of sprint.
Taylor R: Link to PM postmortem for context: https://redwood.company/postmortems/2026-03-22-service-degradation
Maria P: Current rollback: 5xx >2% global. Proposal: require 2 signals in 10m window (p95 latency, user_error_rate, 5xx ramp).
Jon S: Add saturation cap: bucket_max_users=5000 and staged percents: 1%->10%->100% with guard timers. Also request a global quarantine switch (30s TTL).
Taylor R: I'll draft 1-page oncall checklist: validate signals, run rollback, verify recovery. Due Mon.
Irene C: Recurrence rule example: if same flag+model triggers >=3 incidents in 90d, auto-open remediation epic and tag owner.
Maria P: Small canary synthetic every 5m on canary traffic is a good quick detection step. I'll add test + metrics.
Jon S: Infra review needed for global switches; will loop infra once spec is ready.
Alex K: @remind-bot schedule: "Rollout-safety sync" in 7 days. Prioritize safety over velocity until changes land. :thumbsup:
